camel_example: aliyun live SendLiveMessageGroup --region cn-hangzhou --AppId demo --SenderId uid1 --GroupId grouptest
description_en: Sends a message to a group
kebab_example: aliyun live send-live-message-group --app-id demo --group-id grouptest --sender-id uid1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendLiveMessageGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application that is used to receive the message
parameters.help_zh: 接收消息的互动消息应用ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the group that receives the message.

Make sure that the specified GroupId is available. Otherwise, a ResourceNotExist error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的GroupId。
请确保传入的GroupId是存在的！否则会返回ResourceNotExist错误
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who sends the message. The ID can be up to 64 bytes in length and can contain letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 发送消息的用户ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
parameters.name: sender_id

parameters.help_en: The additional information about the user who sends the message. The value can be up to 512 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 发送消息用户的扩展信息，长度不超过512字节
parameters.name: sender_meta_info

parameters.help_en: The message body. It can be up to 15 KB in length
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: The message type. The total number of message types sent within a single group cannot exceed 30
parameters.help_zh: 消息类型，单群内发送消息的总类型数不超过30种
parameters.name: msg_type

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the message. This parameter is used to delete the message. The ID can contain only letters and digits and can be up to 64 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 消息唯一标识，可作为删除消息的依据。由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
parameters.name: msg_tid

parameters.help_en: The contribution of the message to the increase in the number of messages of this type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 该消息对于该类消息数量的统计增长值贡献，默认值为1
parameters.name: statics_increase

parameters.help_en:
The weight of the message. Default value: 1.

For low-priority messages such as likes, you can set the weight to 1.
For regular text messages such as bullet comments, you can set the weight to 5.
For high-priority messages such as red envelopes and gifts, you can set the weight to 1000000
parameters.help_zh:
消息权重，默认值为 1。
对于点赞等低优消息，可设置权重为 1；
对于弹幕等普通文本消息，可设置权重为 5；
对于红包、礼物等高优消息，可设置权重为 1000000
parameters.name: weight

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to disable message storage. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false, which indicates that the message is stored for a validity period of 30 days. You can find the message in the response of the ListLiveMessageGroupMessages operation. If you do not need to store the message, set this parameter to true
parameters.help_zh: 设置不存储该消息。默认为 false，表示存储（当前时效30天），可以通过获取查询群组消息查到该消息。如果您的业务不需要存储该消息，请设置为true
parameters.name: no_storage

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to disable message caching to the list of the latest messages in the group. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false, which indicates that the message is cached
parameters.help_zh: 设置不缓存该消息到最近消息列表中。默认为false，表示缓存到群组最近消息列表中
parameters.name: no_cache

parameters.help_en:
The data center, which must be the same as the data center specified in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html. Valid values:

cn-shanghai: Shanghai
ap-southeast-1: Singapore
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

MsgTid.description_en: The unique identifier of the message, which can be used to delete the message. The ID can contain only letters and digits and can be up to 64 bytes in length
MsgTid.description_zh: 消息唯一标识，可作为删除消息的依据。由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节
